facts.text: John mentioned he has been working on a petition and shared a photo of his workmates from a hiking trip.

evidence.quote: I've been busy doing the petition I started - it's tricky but it's been cool getting back in touch with my buddies and gaining support. I got this picture of my workmates when we went on a hiking trip, they really make me keep going!

facts.text: Maria is preparing for a fundraiser at the shelter, aiming to raise money for the basic needs of the homeless.

evidence.quote: I'm busy at the shelter getting ready for a fundraiser next week. Hopefully, I can raise enough to cover basic needs for the homeless.

facts.text: Maria invited John to help with the fundraiser, specifically mentioning a chili cook-off event.

evidence.quote: We need to get the word out about the chili cook-off at the fundraiser. Here's the poster!

facts.text: John expressed willingness to help spread the word about the chili cook-off event.

evidence.quote: Wow, it looks awesome! I'll make sure to spread the word about it.
